Product tasks are the UI wave's phases 0 and 1 (docs/art/ui-quality/report.md section 3.3: steps 1-4 in phase 0; steps 4-7, AD's board 1 and flow review in phase 1). Phase 1 started on 4 November 2026 by the owner's order 3 (CLAUDE.md), with D13's answer (c): at most three UI builders at once, icon batches 3 and 4 deferred (not filed). SV's are the owner's server decisions (docs/decisions/owner-decisions.md, 'Build tasks'); BT's are the protocol's build tasks. O2 and O3 were the owner's reviews; since 30 October 2026 AD does them as ordinary tasks (report.md section 3.4), so no task waits for the owner. The order of 'tasks' is priority. building_cap is three UI builders (D-05, D13 (c)) plus SV, approved by the owner on 30 October 2026. Phase 2 started on 12 November 2026 (lead cycle 70): P1-AD-board-1d let board 1 stand and phase 1's other exit criteria hold (report.md section 3.2); its first tasks are the flow findings (S1, S2) and board 1's note G (AIA-2), within the same cap of three.

messages.text: From the owner (progress report KPIs, measured at main 3c4b791f). Two of your KPIs are worse than expected. (1) First style approval: 7 of 11 points passed at O2 (target 90% or more); B3, B4, B5 and B11 were sent back. Lesson: before you mark a board or keyframe task ready, score every point yourself against AD's rubric (docs/art/ui-quality/gate/rubric.md) and run tools/ui_gate/checks.py value-steps; put that self-score in the handoff evidence. (2) Largest single session: 47M tokens on a 4h task (2.4 times the average; target twice or less). Lesson: work from reduced-size previews, and when a session passes about 20M tokens, write the handoff and end it. Add M1 to acks when read.

From the owner (progress report KPIs, measured at main 3c4b791f). Rework from review is worse than expected: 4.5h, 8% of phase 0 (target 5% or less). Its biggest part was the kit contract: four values in section 2.1 differed from §21.2 and §21.8 and came back as P0-K1-contract-2. Lesson: before asking for approval, check every value in a contract or token file against the design sections it cites, and list that check in the handoff evidence. Add M2 to acks when read.

From the owner (progress report KPIs, measured at main 3c4b791f). Three of your KPIs are worse than expected. (1) Setup failures before checks: 3 (target 0); runs stopped on a missing compile target or lint tool. Lesson: put the fresh-container tool line (rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown aarch64-linux-android aarch64-apple-ios; pip install "gdtoolkit==4.*" "playwright==1.63.0"; then bash client/build.sh) in every agent start prompt, before its first pre-check. (2) Wait from ready to merged: median 2.1h (target 2h or less). Lesson: start a candidate's checks in the same cycle the task turns ready, and batch tasks that became ready together. (3) Scope added: +9.5h (target 4.7h or less). Lesson: when an approval redirects work, plan the whole follow-up chain with estimates at once, not one task at a time (contract-2, tokens, tokens-2 and board-4 came in pieces). Add M3 to acks when read.

From the lead (cycle 49). P1-AIA-kit-6 cannot merge alone: on main plus kit-6 (candidate 37c28af0) check_all fails one test of client/tests/ui_kit_tests.gd, 'the materials off their box's ground are [green_muted, pill_gold_edge], KitSkin.OWN_SHAPE_ONLY is [album, banner_success, bar_track_light, fact, green_muted, island_label, pill_gold_edge, plate, tag]': kit-6 bakes a shape of their own name for seven of the nine, and the list is in client/ui/kit_skin.gd, your file. So do not wait for kit-6 on main. In P1-K1-switch-rest, merge origin/claude/ui-artist at its ready commit 00571a44 into claude/ui-bake (the art is final there; change none of AIA's files), then do the AIA-R19 wiring on top of it, with KitSkin.OWN_SHAPE_ONLY brought to what the atlas now says; loosen no test. Pre-check and guard on that head, then mark ready as usual. The lead merges kit-6 and switch-rest in one candidate and checks your files against main plus kit-6. Add M4 to acks when read.

From the owner, relayed by the overseer (CLAUDE.md order 1, 10 November 2026, 08:28Z): "Deploy and then stop cleanly". Finish P1-K1-switch-rest and stop. If the pre-check and the guard pass on its head by 09:45Z, mark it ready as usual (ready_sha set): the lead's final cycle merges what is ready then. If they do not pass by then, push a save point instead; it is merged in a later round, nothing is lost. Loosen no test to make the time.
